notes.1: The printed heading is VI. The opening spelling harundinibus and adjective obsite are retained.
notes.7: The source prints adposito, without silently regularizing its consonants.
notes.11: The printed contraction standumst is retained without expansion.
notes.13: The source name is Danaeius, with no diaeresis added; pinnas is retained.
notes.20: The printed parenthesis encloses Sic aeternus eas! only; labere fine tuo! follows outside it.
notes.25: The source prints Melie Bithynide. These names are retained exactly.
notes.29: The question mark follows Quid before non Alpheon; the name and punctuation are retained.
notes.31: The source names Xutho, Penee, Creusam and Phthiotum in the following verse are retained.
notes.41: The source reads Euanthe and Inopide, and verse43 Salmonida and Enipeus; no normalized name forms are substituted.
notes.46: The source prints Tiburis Argei. Verse51 has Anien.
notes.53: The printed speech opens at quid nostras, closes before dixit, and reopens at teris. It continues through66. The source53–54 wording and name Laumedonte are retained.
notes.56: The source prints inpedit, with n.
notes.61: The repeated Ilia, pone metus! appears in61 and62 and is retained.
notes.71: The source reads Sera tamen, not a supplied alternative.
notes.73: A new quoted speech opens before O utinam and closes after pudor! at78. Lecta forent and the subsequent wording are retained.
notes.83: The printed contraction credibilest is retained without expansion.
notes.94: The printed spelling hiemps occurs here and at106.
notes.97: The source reads tum potuit, retained without adjustment.
notes.98: Only perennis eas is enclosed in quotation marks; the question mark follows the closing quote.
notes.101: The source punctuation is Huic ego vae! demens ... amores!, with both exclamation marks retained.
notes.103: The source has Nescio quem hunc spectans Acheloon et Inachon amnem. No alternative words or names are supplied.
notes.106: The poem ends here; VII. begins below on the same printed page and is boundary evidence only.
